recipient.description: Who receives this distro, for people reading the profile. Required unless every target is an `archive`; such a profile defaults to early adopters who are handed the zip or upload it themselves.

include.description: Skills to deliver, with everything they require. `plugin:glob` or a bare glob that matches a skill name in any plugin.

exclude.description: Skills never to deliver. Resolving fails when an included skill is excluded or requires one.

acknowledge.description: Skills a delivered file names that do not ship, accepted as they are.

readme.description: Generate a README listing the shipped skills; always on where the layout holds plugins.

exclude.description: Globs, relative to each skill directory, of files never to deliver.

target-files.description: Opt out of a target-file set of the source repo with `<set>: false`.

name.description: File name of the zip, without `.zip`. Defaults to the distro name and the layout's shape, as in `acme-skills`.
File name of the package, without `.zip`. Defaults to the distro name.

title.description: The pack's name, as the heading of its README. Defaults to the distro name.

layout.description: How this target lays out the delivered tree. Defaults to shape `skills`.

shape.description: `skills`: the skills side by side, without plugins. `plugin`: one plugin holding every shipped skill, with `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` at its root, as Claude Desktop and claude.ai take it for an upload. `marketplace`: the source's plugins that ship a skill, one or several, with a generated `marketplace.json`.

root.description: Subdirectory inside the target that receives the tree: a relative path without `..`.

name.description: Shape `plugin`: the plugin's name. Defaults to the distro name.

description.description: Shape `plugin`: the plugin's description. Defaults to a sentence naming the included skills.

marketplace.description: Shape `marketplace`: the name of the generated marketplace. Defaults to the distro name.

flatten.description: Shape `marketplace`: merge every shipped skill into one plugin, whichever source plugin it comes from. Without it the marketplace keeps the source's plugins.

plugin-name.description: With `flatten`: the name of that one plugin. Defaults to the distro name.

plugin-description.description: With `flatten`: the description of that one plugin. Defaults to a sentence naming the included skills.
